{{Quote|I am Drogen Hosh, commander of the droid army here on Argul.|Drogen Hosh|<ref name="OtF" />}}
'''Drogen Hosh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He participated in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and commanded Separatist forces in an [[Battle of Argul|attack]] on the Republic-allied [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Argul]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. During the battle, Hosh's forces surrounded a mesa on which the world's last Republic-controlled [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Mooring tower/Legends|docking tower]] was located, and shot down the one remaining Republic [[Transport/Legends|transport]] on the planet. Hosh watched the aftermath of the crash through a pair of [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]] and noticed a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] aiding the crash survivors via a stairwell built into the side of the mesa. He developed a plan to use the stairwell as a route to attack the mesa, and launched an assault on the landform when nightfall hit. The following morning, Hosh contacted a group of Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] who were leading Republic forces on the mesa, and attempted to broker a ceasefire with them, because he believed that an all-out strike on the position would cost civilian lives.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I want to end the hostilities on this world, but I am also obligated to bring Argul under the control of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.|Drogen Hosh|<ref name="OtF" />}}
Drogen Hosh was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict that was fought between the Confederacy and the Republic, Hosh commanded Confederacy forces during their [[Battle of Argul|attack]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Argul]].<ref name="OtF" />

The fighting on Argul was fierce, and the Republic began to evacuate [[Argullian]] citizens from the world's war-torn [[City/Legends|cites]]. However, Hosh sent some [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to advance into [[Lumica]]&mdash;the world's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city&mdash;and surround a mesa on which the world's last remaining Republic-controlled [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Mooring tower/Legends|docking tower]] on Argul was sited. There, the commander's [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] shot down the only Republic [[Transport/Legends|transport]] left on the planet, an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] that was attempting to take refugees off of Argul. Hosh watched the aftermath of the crash using a pair of [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]], and witnessed a number of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] cut through the wall of a stairwell built into the side of the mesa, so that they could reach the crash site and rescue survivors. Equipped with the knowledge that there were stairwells leading up to the top of the mesa, Hosh began to develop a plan to take the mesa and the docking tower by sending troops up the stairs. He correctly assumed that the stairwells were blocked at ground-level and also believed that the Jedi would just block the stairwells further up if they saw his forces excavating them. He therefore sent a [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] of battle droids to excavate a stairwell under the cover provided by the smoke billowing out of the wrecked ''Acclamator'', allowing them to work while unseen by the Republic forces.<ref name="OtF" />

At nightfall, Hosh implemented the next stage of his plan, sending a [[Dropship/Legends|dropship]] to the mesa to land 12 [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]], while 36 battle droids ascended the landform via the unblocked stairwell. He ordered the droids to seize the docking facility's [[Control tower/Legends|control tower]] and capture everyone inside it, because he suspected that important Argullian officials had taken shelter there. However, the Republic forces and a group of Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] mobilized to combat the droids.<ref name="OtF" />

The next morning, at dawn, Hosh sent a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] message to the Padawans atop the mesa, proposing a ceasefire. Hosh believed that an all-out assault on the position would cost civilian lives, so he offered to halt the Separatist attack and let the Republic forces and the Argullians leave the world when Republic transports returned there. In return for this, he asked that the Jedi hand over all ranking Argullian officials to the Separatist forces, and allow the world to secede to the Confederacy. In an attempt to convince the Jedi that he was not trying to deceive them, Hosh offered himself to them as a hostage, claiming that he would fly to the docking tower in his personal [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] and sign a treaty with the Argullians, then hand himself over to the Jedi and remain with them until the return of the Republic transports. He even offered to deliver food and medical supplies to the Argullian refugees on the mesa, if the Jedi accepted his proposal.<ref name="OtF" />

{{RPG}}
The Jedi declined Hosh's offer, which disappointed him. Nevertheless, he admired their tenacity and told them that he would have done the same thing if he had been in their position. Shortly afterward, he launched an all-out attack on the mesa, sending battle droids to attack it from all sides. The Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] arrived on Argul with [[Sullustan task force|Republic reinforcements]], however, turning the tide of the battle in the favor of the Republic and eventually leading to the defeat of the Confederacy forces on the planet.<ref name="OtF" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I have the forces at my disposal to sweep aside your defenses at any time I choose. But many innocent people would be hurt in the process, and I find the idea repellent.|Drogen Hosh|<ref name="OtF" />}}
Drogen Hosh was a reasonably sincere and pleasant man, who did not like to hurt innocent people or cause unnecessary [[Death/Legends|deaths]]. Nonetheless, he was a ruthless tactician and was prepared to take the lives of innocents during the final stages of the battle on Argul, if doing so was the only way to achieve victory for the Confederacy.<ref name="OtF" />

Hosh thought that the Jedi were brave and honorable people, and he also appreciated how important [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] were to members of their [[Jedi Order/Legends|order]]. Yet, he considered the Republic to be corrupt and believed that by following the commands of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]],<ref name="OtF" /> the leader of the Republic,<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> the Jedi Order had forgotten that its true purpose was to maintain peace.<ref name="OtF" />

During the campaign on Argul, Hosh wore a military uniform. Bilingual, he had the ability to speak both [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] and [[Pak Pak/Legends|Pak Pak]],<ref name="OtF" /> the language spoken by the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]].<ref name="Phrase Book">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book and Travel Guide'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Drogen Hosh was created by [[J.D. Wiker]] and appeared in the [[2004]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] supplement ''[[Only the Force]]''. In the supplement, the players role-play as the group of Jedi Padawans to which Hosh offers a cease fire. If [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]] [[Mozim]], the highest-ranking Argullian official left on Argul, is present with the Jedi when they receive Hosh's message, the Argullian urges the players not to accept the commander's offer. If the Jedi do choose to accept Hosh's offer, they can then force Mozim to agree to surrender to the commander.<ref name="OtF" />

If the players surrender to Hosh, the commander fulfills his promises. He travels to the docking tower and handles Argul's formal surrender, then presents his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] to the Jedi and enters into their custody. Afterward, Hosh orders the Separatist forces to bring medical supplies, [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]], and food to the mesa, and asks the Jedi and their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to disarm themselves in return. He then takes personal charge of the Jedi's lightsabers and promises to keep the weapons safe until the Jedi depart Argul. Hosh also tries to persuade the Jedi to join the Confederacy and, if any of the player characters agree to his suggestion, the commander arranges for them to be transported off of Argul before the arrival of the Republic transports and Master Yoda. Any of the Jedi who choose to join the Separatist cause are later introduced by Hosh to [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the leader of the Confederacy.<ref name="OtF" />
